returns.name: Form AR3MAR, Employer's Annual Reconciliation of Income Tax Withheld
contents: Filed on or before February 28 (or within 30 days after the business ends) with payment of any tax due for the previous calendar year; the monthly AR941M payments are reconciled with the W-2s.
The AR3MAR is mailed separately from the monthly payment vouchers near the end of the tax year.

returns.name: Form ARW3, Transmittal of Tax and Wage Statements, with the state copy of the W-2s
contents: Due on or before January 31 (or within 30 days after the business ends); employees receive their W-2s by January 31.
Forms W-2 and 1099 are filed electronically by magnetic media, the W-2 submission website or ATAP; paper copies of 1099s go with a photocopy of Form 1096.

deposits.interpretation: Arkansas has two filing statuses. MONTHLY (every new registration starts here, and it stays until the Commissioner notifies a change): Arkansas income tax withheld on payments made in a calendar month must be RECEIVED on or before the 15th of the following month, with Form AR941M or electronically; a zero voucher is required for a month with no tax. ANNUAL: an employer whose total Arkansas income tax withheld is under $1,000 for the calendar year AND who has been notified by the Commissioner of the change in classification pays by January 31 of the following year; annual is an INPUT (the notification), never derived, and a return and voucher are required even for a year with no tax. The look-back amount supplied is therefore ignored (an amount draws an error rather than a guess). Due dates on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday move to the next business day. THIS IS THE JULY 2024 EDITION.

channels.function: withholding payments (AR941M, annual vouchers), AR3MAR, W-2/1099 filing
channels.description: Arkansas Taxpayer Access Point (ATAP): online returns and payments; EFT by ACH Credit (CCD+TXP format) or ACH Debit (call the DFA EFT Unit); electronic W-2/1099 by magnetic media, the W-2 submission website or ATAP
enrollment: Register the withholding account with the Department (EIN-based); the instructions say preprinted AR941M vouchers are mailed once a year or after registration.

Register for ATAP at atap.arkansas.gov for online filing and payment; ACH Credit needs the employer's bank to be able to initiate CCD+TXP credits carrying the amount, federal EIN, tax type code and monthly period ending date; ACH Debit needs contact with the DFA EFT Unit.
Employers averaging $20,000 a month in Arkansas withholding must pay electronically.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (Form DWS-ARK-209B)
contents: Report and payment are due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; payments are delinquent if not postmarked or received by the last day of the month after the quarter.
Interest of 1.5% a month accrues on delinquent payments (handbook).
